purpose: Validate Crypton Agent Authorization Assessment Methodology v0.1 (docs/methodology/) against a real, unfamiliar, non-lab AI application -- not a framework research run like EXP-003A/B/C.

target.name: OpenHands Software Agent SDK
target.version_verification_method: read pyproject.toml directly from the cloned commit, not trusted from README or prompt text, per the standing rule in docs/methodology/04-framework-adaptation-guide.md

scope.workflow_in_scope: Single-conversation action execution with confirmation policy + security analyzer gating, and the two multi-agent delegation primitives (DelegateTool, TaskToolSet) built on top of it.
components_out_of_scope: Docker/sandbox runtime internals (openhands-agent-server/docker_runtime) -- would require executing untrusted code in a live sandbox, out of scope for a static/source-review pass
Prompt injection / jailbreak resistance of the underlying LLM -- explicitly out of scope per docs/ASSESSMENT_METHODOLOGY.md, consistent with prior EXP-00X labs
MCP OAuth store, VS Code / canvas extensions -- not part of the core authorization surface
scope.why_this_scope: Mirrors the Assessment Pack's default engagement shape (one workflow, a bounded set of connected components) rather than reviewing the entire ~1700-file monorepo, per docs/business/ASSESSMENT_PACK.md §B.

method.procedure: Stages 1-13 of docs/methodology/03-assessment-methodology-v0.1.md, run end-to-end for the first time against a genuinely unfamiliar target (prior runs, EXP-003A/B/C, entered at stage 6).
test_methods_not_used: controlled staging test against a live running instance
method.reason_live_execution_excluded: Exercising the real authorization surface end-to-end requires a live LLM (API key/cost) plus, for several tools, a sandboxed container runtime. The mission rules for this experiment (academic security research, no dependence on undefined behavior, no execution against third-party infrastructure without clear low-risk local scope) and the effort budget for a single research pass favor static source review, which the existing methodology already sanctions as a first-class Stage 9 test method and which EXP-003's Threat Model doc itself uses for several NOT_APPLICABLE findings. Every conclusion below is either a literal source citation (file:line, commit-pinned) or explicitly marked INCONCLUSIVE with the reason.
